commit: Stats card: migrate from show_total_reviews to show option (resolves #2836)

truth.description: The test tagged for the endpoint's pass-through compares the card /api sends with renderStatsCard called on the same show option, so both sides render the same card with or without the change and nothing checks that the reviews line appears.

distractions.why: Markdown prints a bare <3 as text because it starts no tag, so the line renders as it did with the entity.
